description: List currency pairs matching a base currency and/or quote currency (ISO codes, comma-separated for several), or matching a free-text query on symbol or name (e.g. query='EURUSD').

base_currency.description: Base currency of the pair as an ISO code, e.g. 'EUR' in EURUSD. Several values: comma-separated (e.g. 'A, B') or a list. Case-insensitive.
base_currency.title: Base Currency

include_summary.description: Add the business/fund description (truncated to 300 characters). Off by default to keep responses small.
include_summary.title: Include Summary

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging (see the `_notes` hint in the response).
offset.title: Offset

query.description: Optional free-text search on symbol and name (case-insensitive substring, e.g. 'apple' or 'AAPL'); an ISIN also matches where available. Best matches come first.
query.title: Query

quote_currency.description: Quote currency of the pair as an ISO code, e.g. 'USD' in EURUSD. Several values: comma-separated (e.g. 'A, B') or a list. Case-insensitive.
quote_currency.title: Quote Currency

show_columns.description: Columns to return, comma-separated. Default: symbol, name, base_currency, quote_currency, exchange. Available: symbol, name, base_currency, quote_currency, summary, exchange.
show_columns.title: Show Columns

name: currencies
